deploymentDetailBlock.title: Deployment Detail
deploymentDetailBlock.description: A deployment snapshot combining website preview, metadata, domains, source and stage results with the Project Monitor and Model Router surfaces.
deploymentDetailBlock.compositionBody: Uses Card, InfoItem, Avatar, Badge, StatusOverview, Button, Popover, Dropdown and Tooltip. A continuous content panel and footer use existing semantic colors, typography, spacing and surfaces, with narrow-container and dark-theme support.
deploymentDetailBlock.dataContractBody: The host supplies deployment status, timestamps, domains, source and stages. Timestamps and durations use milliseconds. Ticks represent actual checks or equal-duration timeline buckets rather than invented progress. Issue counts come from stage issue lists; readiness and check results are independent. The preview uses example data without a live deployment connection.
deploymentDetailBlock.behaviorBody: Supports sharing, additional domains, copying the commit hash and details for non-build stages. Visit, build logs, run summary and investigate remain visible buttons without click behavior. Host callbacks own external operations; asynchronous actions prevent repeated submissions and report failures. The block supports loading, retry, stale snapshots and missing previews.
